Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good overview of Redwood and how you handle inference at scale. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we proceed:

- Do you accept Purchase Orders (POs) or do you require payment by card?
- If PO: are Net30 invoices supported, and do you run a standard vendor onboarding (W9, vendor form)?
- Any interest/use of cloud marketplace (we run primarily in AWS and prefer marketplace for consolidated billing)?

Hi John — thanks for the thoughtful list. Below is a concise summary you can forward to your procurement team; I included next steps at the bottom.

Commercial / procurement summary:
- Payment methods: We support credit card and invoiced POs. Invoicing terms can be Net30 for customers on contract.
- Paperwork: Standard vendor onboarding accepted (W9, vendor form). For larger deals we provide an SOW/contract and can accommodate reasonable redlines.
- Marketplace: We are currently listed on AWS Marketplace (public), which many customers prefer for consolidated billing and procurement automation. If you prefer us to transact via marketplace, we can provide the SKU and subscription details.
- Signatory path: Small purchases (under $25k) typically handled by the product team; deals $25k–$100k usually require procurement + budget owner sign-off; deals >$100k generally require CFO/finance signatory.

Attachments: I can share our SOW template and an updated pricing sheet.

Next steps / ask:
1) Can you confirm the budget owner (name and email) and whether Acme will purchase via PO or AWS Marketplace?
2) If PO: please confirm preferred billing terms (Net30) and any PO template or required vendor fields.
3) If Marketplace: confirm whether Acme needs any internal paperwork to enable purchase via AWS Marketplace (some customers still prefer a PO for catalog purchases).

I'll loop in Vivek on discounts/approval for any special commercial terms once we know estimated ARR and preferred path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-SOW-template.pdf, Pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few specifics from procurement/finance:

- For initial labs/proof-of-concept (under $50k) we can often use credit card, but for production purchase we will need a PO.
- Preferred billing: Net30 invoice terms are acceptable.
- Onboarding docs: send W9 and standard vendor form; we have a vendor portal for vendor setup.
- Marketplace: Acme prefers AWS Marketplace for SaaS where available; however, because this will be a multi-region dedicated deployment for latency, we typically purchase commercial agreements directly (PO + contract).

Budget owner and signatory: Carlos Ramirez (CFO) will need to approve any spend >$100k. For deals in the $25k–$100k range the economic buyer is our Head of Platform (Maya Singh, me) with Finance sponsorship. I've CC'd Carlos for visibility.

Can you send a redlined SOW and the pricing sheet? Also please include a short note describing the PO/invoice flow so procurement can map it in our system.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Platform, Acme Corp
